restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมForte Plus+
text: This is my second time at this clinic. The first time, I thought the dentist was nice, so I scheduled a second appointment. This time, the treatment took less than 10 minutes! I was so surprised – I've never experienced anything this fast before. I'm not sure if they checked my teeth or not, but they definitely didn't do a fluoride treatment. The price was 950 baht, and I'm not sure if that's cheap or expensive. The first time I paid, I remember it was 1,100 baht. When I got home, I asked my husband about his experience because he went in before me, and he said the same thing – less than 10 minutes! I'm completely baffled. I don't want to compare it to the dental work I've had abroad, where checkups and scaling take almost an hour each time, and the work is much more meticulous. (The prices abroad are definitely higher; paying in person would be around $60, which is much more worthwhile.) I didn't expect to compare because I'd prepared myself for this, as I've said before, but this time was just too much. I'm giving it 3 stars because I thought the first time was better, otherwise I wouldn't have given it even 10 stars.
